title: Lily’s Desert Adventure
moral: Working together helps overcome even the hardest challenges.

scenes.summary: Lily and friends explore a mysterious desert.
scenes.text: Lily and her friends went into the desert to explore and find secrets.
scenes.image_prompt: kids walking in desert with backpacks and pyramid, bright cartoon

scenes.summary: They enter a pyramid and face puzzles.
scenes.text: They entered a pyramid and solved a maze of puzzles inside.
scenes.image_prompt: kids solving maze inside pyramid, adventurous cartoon

scenes.summary: They search for water under the hot sun.
scenes.text: They faced the hot sun and searched for water to stay safe.
scenes.image_prompt: kids walking in hot desert toward oasis, colorful cartoon

scenes.text: They built a shelter and stayed safe during a big sandstorm.
scenes.image_prompt: kids hiding in shelter during sandstorm, dramatic cartoon

scenes.summary: They find a way home through a portal.
scenes.text: They found a glowing portal and returned home safely together.
scenes.image_prompt: kids entering glowing portal in desert, magical cartoon

story: Lily and her friends explored a desert and found a pyramid. Inside, they solved puzzles and found a golden key. They faced the hot sun and a strong sandstorm but worked together to stay safe. Finally, they discovered a glowing portal and returned home, proud of their teamwork and adventure.
